etymology: Compound: withdrawing (去) from the kneeling audience (卩) — sent back: to reject; contrary to expectation (却って).
mnemonic: The petition handed back at the steps — キャク. 返却 returns books; 却下 returns hopes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 却 (phonetic キャク) — the supporting legs: shins, the legs of furniture and arguments.
mnemonic: What everything stands on — あし, キャク. 脚本: the script — a play's legs.

etymology: Compound: the tiger's claw raked downward — cruelty from power: to oppress.
mnemonic: The claw with authority behind it — しいたげる. 虐待: the news word nobody wants.

etymology: Pictograph: two low rises on the plain — a hill.
mnemonic: The mountain's apprentice — おか. 丘の上: every anime's confession spot.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand catching up to a person — to reach, extend to; 'and' in legal lists (及び).
mnemonic: Fingers closing on the runner's shoulder — およぶ. 普及: reaching everyone.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 丂 (phonetic キュウ) — timber gone soft: to rot.
mnemonic: The beam your foot goes through — くちる. 不朽: the works that never do.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hole (穴) + 躬 (phonetic キュウ) — the body bent in the last corner of the cave: destitute, cornered.
mnemonic: Backed into the burrow's end — キュウ. 窮地: the corner with no next move.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 丩 (phonetic キュウ) — cords twisted tight; investigation winding to the truth: to examine severely.
mnemonic: The interrogation braids every loose end — キュウ. 糾弾: censure, rope-tight.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 巨 (phonetic キョ) — the hand held out flat: to refuse.
mnemonic: A palm the size of the request — こばむ. 拒否: no, in writing.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 処 (phonetic キョ) — the grip one stands on: base, grounds.
mnemonic: The handhold the argument climbs from — キョ. 証拠: the grip that holds in court.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic キョ) + a mound — the great abandoned hill: emptiness, falsehood (虚偽).
mnemonic: The tiger guards an empty den — キョ. 虚しい: hollow, echoing.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 巨 (phonetic キョ) — the stretch between footfalls: distance.
mnemonic: Giant steps measured out — キョ. 距離: the number between here and there.

etymology: Pictograph: the offering hall receiving gifts — to receive, partake of.
mnemonic: The hall where blessings are served — キョウ. 享受: enjoying what came down to you.

etymology: Ideograph: a pit with a warning cross in it — misfortune: evil, calamity. The anti-吉.
mnemonic: The fortune slip you fold and tie to the tree — キョウ. 凶器: the bad-luck tool.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 夾 'pressed between' (phonetic キョウ) — squeezed between peaks: a gorge, strait.
mnemonic: Where the mountains stand shoulder to shoulder — キョウ. 海峡: the sea's gorge.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 共 (phonetic キョウ) + heart below — the heart offered with both hands: reverent.
mnemonic: Both hands and the heart, presented — うやうやしい. 恭賀新年: the New Year's deepest bow.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 王 (phonetic キョウ) — the animal running wild: mad, frenzied.
mnemonic: The dog that crowned itself — くるう. 熱狂: crowds doing it together.

etymology: Phono-semantic: arrow (矢) + 喬 (phonetic キョウ) — bending arrows true: to straighten, correct.
mnemonic: The brace that unbends the shaft — キョウ. 歯列矯正: braces, dentally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 劦 'joined force' (phonetic キョウ) + flesh (月) — force pressed against the body: to menace.
mnemonic: Three muscles against one ribcage — おどす. 脅迫: menace, notarized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 郷 (phonetic キョウ) + sound (音) — sound returning across the village: echo, resonance.
mnemonic: The valley answers back — ひびく. 影響: the echo that changes things.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 敬 (phonetic キョウ) + horse (馬) — the horse shying: startled: to be amazed.
mnemonic: Even the horse jumped — おどろく. 驚き: the kanji with its mane up.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 卬 (phonetic ギョウ) — the face turned upward: to look up, revere; to say (honorific おっしゃる).
mnemonic: Chin up toward the higher thing — あおぐ. 信仰: looking up, made a practice.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 疑 (phonetic ギョウ) — hesitation frozen solid: to congeal; attention frozen on one thing: engrossed.
mnemonic: Stuck fast, by frost or fascination — こる. 凝る: hobbies and shoulders, both.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 尭 (phonetic ギョウ) — the sun climbing the mound: dawn; the moment of realizing (暁に).
mnemonic: The sun tops the ridge and everything is known — あかつき. 暁: poetry's favorite hour.

etymology: Compound: cloth (帛) shot with gold (金) — woven splendor: brocade.
mnemonic: Fabric with bullion in the weft — にしき. 錦鯉: the koi wearing it.

etymology: Pictograph: an axe head on its haft — the axe; borrowed for the old weight unit (600g), now bread loaves.
mnemonic: The axe that ended up in the bakery — キン. 食パン一斤: one loaf, by axe-weight.

etymology: Phono-semantic: paired jades (strings' bridges) + 今 (phonetic キン) — the long zither: koto.
mnemonic: Two gem-bright strings and the present moment — こと. 琴: the sound gardens are built around.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic キン) + thread (糸) — the cord drawn taut: tense, urgent.
mnemonic: The thread with no slack left — キン. 緊張: interviews, stages, first dates.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 囷 (phonetic キン) — growth in the sealed store: mold, fungus, bacteria.
mnemonic: What blooms in the closed rice bin — キン. 殺菌: the counterstrike.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 禁 (phonetic キン) — the closing front of the robe: collar; the breast it guards: one's heart (襟を開く).
mnemonic: The garment's border checkpoint — えり. 襟を正す: straightening collar and conduct.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 堇 (phonetic キン) — speech held careful: respectful, discreet.
mnemonic: Words in their Sunday best — つつしむ. 謹賀新年: the card's most careful phrase.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 今 (phonetic ギン) — the drawn-out chant: to recite, hum.
mnemonic: The now (今) sung slowly — ギン. 吟味: tasting words (or sake) line by line.

etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 区 (phonetic ク) — spurring across the district: to gallop, drive.
mnemonic: Hooves through every ward — かける. 駆け込み乗車: the platform gallop.

etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 句 (phonetic ク) — the young horse: pony; the little 'horses' of shōgi: pieces.
mnemonic: The pocket-size horse — こま. 将棋の駒: cavalry you can lose in a tatami seam.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 禺 (phonetic グ) + heart (心) — the heart aping about: folly.
mnemonic: A monkey at the controls of the heart — おろか. 愚痴: folly's favorite output — complaints.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic グ) + 呉 — foreseen danger: apprehension (the legal 〜のおそれ).
mnemonic: The tiger you plan around — おそれ. 虞: statute-book worry.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — met on the road: to encounter; how one is met: treatment (待遇).
mnemonic: The chance meeting that sets your salary — グウ. 待遇: how the road treats you.

etymology: Compound: the body (尸) bent to get out (出) — to bend, submit; bent spirits: boredom (退屈).
mnemonic: Folded double under the low exit — かがむ. 退屈: the spirit slouching.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 喿 (phonetic ソウ→く) — winding thread in: to reel; to turn over in sequence (繰り返す).
mnemonic: Hand over hand on the spool — くる. 繰り返す: rewind, replay, repeat.

etymology: Pictograph: the tree of many picking hands (又×3) — the silkworm's mulberry.
mnemonic: Hands all over the branches at harvest — くわ. 桑: the silk industry's root.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 力 — service that earns the decoration: merit.
mnemonic: Effort that smells of gun-smoke and medals — クン. 勲章: the chest hardware.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + a phonetic — scent carried on smoke: fragrant.
mnemonic: Herbs on the coals — かおる. 薫風: May's perfumed wind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 开 (phonetic ケイ) + blade (刂) — the law's blade: punishment.
mnemonic: The sentence with an edge — ケイ. 刑事: the detective who serves it.

etymology: Compound: the hand opening the door (戸) for the word (口) — to open, instruct; letters' opening bow (拝啓).
mnemonic: Door opened, truth announced — ケイ. 拝啓: the letter's knock.

etymology: Compound: the tally notched with a blade — the cut both parties keep: pledge, contract.
mnemonic: One cut, two halves, one promise — ちぎる. 契約: the notch, in triplicate.

etymology: Compound: bringing a deer-hide gift with a glad heart — congratulation, felicity.
mnemonic: Arriving with gifts and a full heart — ケイ. 慶応: the era, the university, the joy.

etymology: Compound: catching breath (息) and tongue — pausing: rest.
mnemonic: Breath and voice both on break — いこい. 休憩: the ten sacred minutes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 曷 (phonetic ケイ) — raised for all to see: to post, hoist.
mnemonic: Pinned at eye height — かかげる. 掲示板: the bulletin board, then the internet forum.
